## 🌎 Major world changes
- **Data center backlash reshapes global tech landscape:** A political and social revolt against energy-intensive AI data centers is gaining momentum. In the US midterms, 40 out of 41 local ballot measures placed limits on data center construction [[Times of India]](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/ai-electricity-bills-and-voter-anger-how-data-centres-tanked-trumps-midterm-hopes/articleshow/135634353.cms) [[TechCrunch]](https://techcrunch.com/podcast/how-a-blue-wave-midterm-might-reshape-the-ai-industry/). In Europe, environmental protesters broke into Microsoft data center sites in Amsterdam [[Latest News]](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/data-centre-protesters-microsoft-amsterdam-europe-6531886). Hyperscalers are facing rising electricity costs, grid limits, and regulatory scrutiny that threaten to slow down the pace of AI deployment.

## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **What is an Offer for Sale (OFS) in an IPO?** When a company lists on the stock market, its IPO can consist of a "fresh issue", an "offer for sale", or both. In a fresh issue, the company creates new shares and receives cash to expand its business. In an Offer for Sale (OFS), existing owners—such as founders or private equity investors—sell their current shares to the public. The money raised in an OFS goes directly into the pockets of the selling shareholders, not into the company's bank account. For example, Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings' upcoming ₹9,500 crore IPO is 100% an OFS, meaning all proceeds go to existing promoters while the bottling company receives ₹0 for expansion.
